_comment: Golden SQL per Postgres write operation. Mirrored verbatim into drakkar-go so both backends emit byte-identical statements and bind values in the same order. Column maps are [name, value] PAIR LISTS rather than JSON objects because object key order is not preserved by every JSON decoder. Emitted columns are SORTED, never left in the order the payload model declares them: Go decodes payload data into a map with no order to preserve, so sorting is the only rule both backends can honour unconditionally. A case whose pairs are not already sorted therefore expects sorted SQL. 'rows' carries one entry per batched row; insert and upsert cases with several rows pin the continuous parameter numbering of one multi-row statement.

cases.case: insert three rows numbers parameters continuously
insert two rows of a single column
update numbers SET values before WHERE values
update null predicate renders IS NULL and consumes no parameter
cases.expected_sql: UPDATE "jobs" SET "status" = $1 WHERE "id" = $2 AND "claimed_by" IS NULL

cases.case: update whose predicate is entirely IS NULL
update hoists IS NULL predicates after the equalities regardless of mapping order
cases.expected_sql: UPDATE "jobs" SET "status" = $1 WHERE "id" = $2 AND "owner" = $3 AND "a" IS NULL AND "b" IS NULL

cases.case: upsert defaults update_columns to every data column outside the conflict target
cases.expected_sql: INSERT INTO "totals" ("day", "hits") VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT ("day") DO UPDATE SET "hits" = EXCLUDED."hits"

cases.case: upsert with an explicit update_columns subset preserves the unnamed columns
cases.expected_sql: INSERT INTO "sessions" ("created_at", "id", "last_seen") VALUES ($1, $2, $3) ON CONFLICT ("id") DO UPDATE SET "last_seen" = EXCLUDED."last_seen"

cases.case: upsert where every data column is a conflict column becomes DO NOTHING
cases.expected_sql: INSERT INTO "seen" ("key") VALUES ($1) ON CONFLICT ("key") DO NOTHING

cases.case: upsert with an explicitly empty update_columns is DO NOTHING even with overwritable columns
cases.expected_sql: INSERT INTO "sessions" ("id", "last_seen") VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT ("id") DO NOTHING

cases.case: upsert with a multi-column conflict target
cases.expected_sql: INSERT INTO "m" ("a", "b", "c") VALUES ($1, $2, $3) ON CONFLICT ("a", "b") DO UPDATE SET "c" = EXCLUDED."c"

cases.case: upsert batching several rows into one statement
cases.expected_sql: INSERT INTO "totals" ("day", "hits") VALUES ($1, $2), ($3, $4) ON CONFLICT ("day") DO UPDATE SET "hits" = EXCLUDED."hits"

cases.case: upsert conflict target need not be one of the inserted columns
cases.expected_sql: INSERT INTO "t" ("id") VALUES ($1) ON CONFLICT ("generated_key") DO UPDATE SET "id" = EXCLUDED."id"
